The '''Barren Tract''' was the name given to the field south of the [[Watchtower (Oricon)|Watchtower]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Oricon]], where the [[Dread Masters]]' forces tried to install a number of terraforming devices during the [[Dread War]]. At the southern side of the Tract, ruined steps led to the [[Dread Cavern]].<ref name="TOR" />
